g.text: Drawing MFG-EX-BAR-01 | Part EX-BAR-01 — ID16.20 x OD34 barrel | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: SCM440 (KS D3867/JIS G4105 equivalent) QT + gas nitride bore | Process/finish: deep drill, stress relieve, ream/hone, port,
die-interface thread and sensor bores, nitride, final hone
Overall: X 34.000 × Y 34.000 × Z 280.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: L280.00; ID16.20 +0.02/0 after hone; OD34.00 -0.03/0 after finish grind; 4x M4-6H depth8 PCD26; 3x Ø3.20 +0.05/0 blind5.5 sensor bores
at B+95/170/245; minimum bore ligament 3.32; outer/inner thread ligament >=2.0/2.9; Datum B rear face/C front face; bore axis Datum D; SCM440 QT
28–32 HRC; gas nitride 0.30–0.50 mm, surface ≥900 HV; final hone bore Ra 0.4–0.8 µm; three-station bore report
GD&T/datums: A=common journal/bore axis; B=drive/feed datum face; C=feed-port angular plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; certified material/heat-treatment report;
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Release: PASS — physical validation NOT_RUN; procurement and machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
